chip.description: Master System VDP: tile layer, sprites, raster timing and palette on one die, with the TMS9918A legacy modes (taxonomy §4.20 example). Also used on Sega System E arcade hardware.
chip.notes: src/devices/video/315_5124.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Implementation of video hardware chips used by Sega System E, Master System, and Game Gear"), device full name "Sega 315-5124 SMS1 VDP". The repo already carries the later 315-5246 (SMS2) revision.
